mapper.select: SELECT address, latitude, longitude, ST_Distance( coordinate, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography --경도,위도 순서 ) AS distance_m FROM TB_CCTV_INFO WHERE ST_DWithin( coordinate, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography, 100 ) ORDER BY distance_m;
